MIND. [1] [Graph.]
Sadness, with thoughts of nothing but death.
Sad, despondent ; she must weep ; music makes her weep.
Feels miserable, unhappy.
Apprehensiveness, with inclination to weep, in frequent attacks.
Fidgety while sitting at work.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Graph.]
Pain as if constricted, especially in occiput, extending to nape of neck, which pains on looking up, as if broken.
Pain as if head were numb and pithy.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Graph.]
Itching on scalp.
Burning round spot on top of head.
Humid eruption on vertex, painful to touch.
Scurfy spots on vertex, with violent sore pain when touched.
Much scaliness on head, causing distressing itching, becomes scurf, which disappears on washing, and is then humid.
Eczema capitis, of entire scalp, forming massive, dirty crusts, which mat the hair together ; painful and sore to touch.
Falling out of hair of scalp.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Graph.]
External canthi : sore and fissured ; fissured and bleed easily.
Edges of lids much inflamed.
Eczema of lids, eruption moist and fissured, margins of lids covered with scales or crusts.
Lids red and margins covered with scurfs.
Dry mucus in lashes.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Graph.]
Hears better when in a noise ; when riding in a carriage.
Swelling of both ears, with moist eruption behind ears.
Behind the ears ; moisture ; fissures ; sore places ; scabs ; itching.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Graph.]
Smell abnormally acute ; she cannot tolerate flowers.
Dryness of nose, sometimes painful.
Sore sensation in nose on blowing it.
Sneezing : on opening eyes ; with very dry nose or running coryza.
Stoppage of nose, with secretion of tough, badly-smelling mucus.
Excoriation of nose.
Dry scabs in nose, with sore, cracked and ulcerated nostrils.
Nose painful internally.
Nose sore, surrounded by thick, moist scabs.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Graph.]
Flushes of heat in face.
Constant sensation as of a cobweb on face.
Itching pimples on face, becoming moist after scratching.
Moist eczema on face.
Erysipelas : of both sides of face, with burning, stinging pain ; of cheeks, preceded by alternating chills and heat ; of left cheek, after mal-application of Iodium for sore of inner nose ; of face, from smell of wood ; commencing on right side and going to left.
   

LOWER FACE. [9] [Graph.]
Soreness and cracking of lips and nostrils as from cold.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Graph.]
Taste in mouth as of rotten eggs every morning, which nauseates her.
Burning blisters on lower side and tip of tongue.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Graph.]
Excessive hunger.
Aversion : to animal food, when thinking of it ; to fish ; to cooked food.
Sweet things are disgusting and nauseous.
   

EATING AND DRINKING. [15] [Graph.]
Pains in stomach necessitate eating.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Graph.]
Constrictive pain in stomach.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Graph.]
Hardness in region of liver.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Graph.]
Pain in upper abdomen, as if everything would be torn to pieces during menstruation.
Pain below navel, as if intestines were torn.
Burning pains radiating through abdomen. θ Gastralgia.
Colic immediately after eating.
Heaviness in abdomen.
Great distension of abdomen, with dulness and heaviness of head.
Full abdomen, as from accumulation and incarceration of flatus ; she cannot bear anything tight about hypochondria.
Herpetic eruption in groins.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Graph.]
Excessive discharge of flatus.
Stools brown, fluid, mixed with undigested substances, and of an intolerable fetor.
Stools knotty, the lumps being united by mucous threads ; even after stool there is still mucus coming from anus.
Constipation ; stool large, knotty.
Hard stool, with much urging and sticking in anus.
Obstinate constipation and delayed menstruation occur together.
Discharge of mucus from rectum.
Hemorrhoids of rectum, with burning rhagades at anus.
Smarting, sore pain in anus on wiping it.
Itching of anus.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Graph.]
Urine becomes turbid and deposits a white sediment.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Graph.]
Almost involuntary emission, without much erection, during an embrace.
Sexual debility from sexual abuse.
Decided aversion to coition.
Itching and moist eruption on scrotum.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Graph.]
Leucorrheic discharge occurs in gushes day or night.
Itching of pudenda before menstruation.
Acrid, excoriating leucorrhœa, in gushes, day and night, before and after menses.
Leucorrhœa ; profuse, perfectly white, especially on rising in morning ; weakness of back when walking or sitting, with distension of abdomen, and painful pressure towards pudenda ; discharges occur in gushes day and night ; turbid urine ; frequent micturition, especially at night ; difficult stool ; great lassitude.
During climaxis : cardialgia ; gastric catarrh.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Graph.]
Hard cicatrices remaining after mammary abscess, retarding flow of milk.
Cancer of mamma, from old cicatrices, which had remained after repeated abscesses.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Graph.]
Constriction of the chest, as if too narrow.
   

COUGH. [27] [Graph.]
Cough at night.
   

OUTER CHEST. [30] [Graph.]
Hard scars remaining after mammary abscesses.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Graph.]
Painless swollen glands on side of neck.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Graph.]
Skin of hands hard and cracked.
Finger-nails become thick.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Graph.]
Smarting soreness between nates.
Soreness high up between thighs, during and after walking.
Tetters in hollow of knee.
Cold feet in evening in bed.
Œdema pedum from amenorrhœa.
   

NERVES. [36] [Graph.]
Weak exhaustion of whole body.
Cataleptic condition ; conscious, but without power to move or speak.
Numbness and deadness, with coldness of fingers of both hands, extending as far as middle of upper arm ; coldness and numbness of face, < left side ; great vertigo and blindness, with prostration of strength ; face pale and haggard ; much emaciation without perceptible cause ; both kidneys sore, with ischuria. θ Paralysis.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Graph.]
Constant yawning, with bloatedness of gastric region.
Disturbed sleep.
Dreams : vivid ; anxious ; horrible ; vexations ; about fatal accidents.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Graph.]
Emaciation of suffering parts.
   

TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [Graph.]
Overlifting, easily.
   

SKIN. [46] [Graph.]
Nightly heat. θ Keratitis.
Unhealthy skin ; every injury suppurates.
Cracks or fissures of ends of fingers and nipples, labial commissures, of anus, between toes, etc.
Itching eruption full of corrosive water in many parts of body.
Erysipelas in face commencing on right side and extending to left.
Eruption behind ears, on various parts, from which ooze a watery, transparent, sticky fluid ; nails brittle, crumbling, deformed, painful and sore, as if ulcerated.
Eczema, with profuse serous exudations ; in blondes inclined to obesity.
Herpes exuding a sticky matter.
Old hard scars.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Graph.]
Adapted to women inclined to obesity, who suffer from habitual constipation, and whose history reveals a tendency to delaying menstruation.
